title: Burning and Suppression of Solids - II (BASS-II)
Flame Extinguishment Experiment - 2 (FLEX-2)
summary: Parameter ranges as stated in the PSI-68 Experimental Table (parameter-space summary, not individual test rows). Fuel types tested: IsoOctane (pure), n-Octane (pure), Heptane (pure), Decane (pure), Ethanol (pure), Propanol (95%) Glycerol (5%) (mixture), Heptane (50%) IsoOctane (50%) (mixture), Propanol (80%) Glycerol (20%) (mixture). Ambient gas mixture: 'O2/N2 or O2/He'. Oxygen mole fraction: '0.17; 0.21; 0.25; 0.3'. Ambient pressure (atm): '0.5; 1.0; 1.5; 2.0; or 3.0'. Ambient temperature (C): 25. Flow velocity (cm/s): '0.1 - 5'. Initial droplet diameter (mm): '1.5 - 5'. No individual test run rows were present in this file; no rows were loaded into the tests table.
